queries_run: SharkNinja antitrust OR FTC OR DOJ OR regulatory investigation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素稱公司過去及未來可能面臨涉及競爭與反壟斷等事項的訴訟或政府調查，屬一般性風險揭露，未指明具體反壟斷調查；2026 年搜尋未見 FTC/DOJ/EU 對 SharkNinja 的反壟斷調查或拆分報導。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: From time to time, we have been, and may continue to be, subject to claims, lawsuits, including class actions, government investigations and other proceedings involving products liability, competition and antitrust, intellectual property, privacy, consumer protection, securities, tax, labor and employment, commercial disputes and other matters that could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋結果僅回 SEC 申報檔，無新聞或 FTC/DOJ 來源顯示具體調查。
